brand.name: engram
brand.tagline: Type one word you still remember.

landing.heroTitle: Type one word you still remember.
landing.heroSub: engram stores everything under keywords you choose. Type one word, get the whole note back.
landing.demoCaption: Sample data — type freely, nothing is sent anywhere.
landing.wallSub: Small things, needed often, always filed somewhere you can't recall.
landing.jsonTitle: Paste JSON, read it as a table
landing.jsonBody: Router config, API responses, exports — paste them as-is. Nested objects open level by level, arrays become tables with columns.
landing.jsonNote: Edit one cell and only that cell changes. A long number like 9007199254740993 keeps every digit; nothing is rounded behind your back.
landing.privacyTitle: Plainly: what is encrypted and what is not
landing.privacyBody1: Entry content will be locked in your browser with a key only your machine holds. We keep no copy and have no way to read it.
landing.privacyBody2: Item names and tags are not encrypted — they are what makes search work. If you turn on similar-meaning search, those two are sent to an embedding server we run ourselves. Entry content never is, even then.
landing.encBody: The content of every text and json entry.
landing.plainBody: Item names, tag names, edit times, entry counts.
landing.cryptoNote: XChaCha20-Poly1305 · Argon2id · keys never leave the browser
landing.recoveryTitle: Forgetting your passphrase is not losing everything
landing.recoveryBody: Because we do not hold your key, you need your own way back. There are three, set up at sign-up.
landing.recoveryKeysBody: Print them, put them away. Each one opens the vault on its own, once.
landing.recoveryPasskeyBody: Fingerprint or security key. Open the vault without typing anything.
landing.recoveryDeviceBody: Your usual machine opens straight away; an unfamiliar one does not.
landing.ctaBody: Free, no cap on items. Needs an email and a passphrase you use nowhere else.
landing.previewNote: This build is a UI preview: sign-up, vault and encryption arrive in a later build.

states.emptyBody: Save your first item by typing a keyword and pressing Enter.

onboarding.title: Create your vault
onboarding.body: Vault setup, passphrase, and recovery keys arrive in P03. In P02 you can still manage your account and sessions.
onboarding.absent: This account has no encrypted vault yet. When P03 is ready, you will set a passphrase and receive recovery keys here.
onboarding.present: A vault already exists — lock and unlock are handled in P03.

step1.title: Set your vault passphrase
step1.leadMiddle: (it locks your entry contents) and is completely separate from your account
step1.leadSuffix: . The server never keeps a copy — if you forget it, no one can open your vault for you.

rules.distinctFromLogin: Do not reuse your login password or a password from another site

step1.warningBanner: If you lose your passphrase without a recovery key, passkey, or remembered device, your entry contents cannot be recovered. The next step prepares 10 recovery keys for you.

errors.tooShort: Passphrase must be at least 12 characters (after Unicode NFC normalization).
errors.tooWeak: Passphrase is too easy to guess. Add more uncommon words or characters until strength reaches Strong (zxcvbn ≥ 3).
errors.invalidUnicode: Passphrase contains invalid Unicode characters. Re-type your passphrase.

oom.title: Not enough memory to create your vault
oom.body: This browser could not allocate 64 MiB in the Web Worker to derive your encryption key (Argon2id). This device cannot create a vault right now — close other tabs or try another browser or device. Nothing was sent to the server.

step2.title: Your 10 recovery keys
step2.lead: Each key unlocks your vault on its own without your passphrase. Consuming a key deletes it on the live server.
step2.screenshotWarningBody: A screenshot or someone looking over your shoulder can take these keys. Print or download the file and store it offline — do not leave screenshots on a shared machine.
step2.gridCaption: Each key is 16 random bytes encoded in Crockford Base32 (26 characters).
step2.copiedStatus: Copied 10 keys · clipboard clears in 30 seconds
step2.confirmSavedLabel: I have saved all 10 recovery keys in a safe place outside this browser.
step2.disabledHint: Unlocks after you tick the box above. Nothing has been sent to the server yet.

vaultExists.title: Vault was created elsewhere (another tab or device)
vaultExists.bodyPrefix: This account already has a vault before this request finished.
vaultExists.bodyStrong: The 10 recovery keys just generated belong to no vault — discard them immediately
vaultExists.bodySuffix: (do not keep, print, or use that set of keys).

errors.networkBody: Your connection dropped before the server confirmed creation. Retry safely — we reuse the same request key so a second vault is never created.
errors.inProgressTitle: Vault creation is still in progress
errors.inProgressBody: The previous request is still being processed. Wait a moment and retry with the same request key.
errors.conflictBody: The request state changed. Reload to check whether your vault was already created.
errors.mutationsDisabledTitle: Vault key changes are temporarily paused
errors.mutationsDisabledBody: Creating a new vault is temporarily disabled for maintenance (503 vault_mutations_disabled). Please try again later.
errors.emailNotVerifiedTitle: Verify your email before creating a vault
errors.emailNotVerifiedBody: Your account email must be verified before you can create a vault.
errors.rateLimitedBody: Please wait {seconds} seconds before trying again.
errors.genericBody: Something went wrong while saving your vault. You can retry safely.

password.short: Password must be at least 12 characters.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: This step only opens your account. Unlocking the vault is a separate step.
login.passwordHint: Your login password is not your vault passphrase. Changing it does not erase encrypted data.

signup.title: Create account
signup.subtitle: After this you will set a passphrase and receive recovery keys.
signup.terms: I agree to the terms and how data is handled.
signup.privacyNote: We cannot read what you store. If you lose every way to unlock, we cannot recover it for you.

guard.unavailableBody: Network or server error. Try again — this is not a sign-out.

verify.title: Verify email
verify.subtitle: Open the link in your email, then confirm on this signed-in device. The token stays in memory only.
verify.resendHint: Did not arrive? Check spam or resend after a minute.
verify.invalidToken: This link expired, was already used, or belongs to another session.
verify.signInRequired: Sign in with the correct account, then open the link again.

enroll.title: Set login password
enroll.subtitle: OAuth-only accounts need a login password for sensitive actions when the provider cannot re-authenticate. This is not vault recovery.
enroll.sendHint: We email a link to your verified address. Open it on this signed-in session.
enroll.noToken: Open the link from your email on this device.
enroll.invalidToken: This setup link is invalid or expired.
enroll.signInRequired: Sign in on the device that requested the link.

reauth.title: Confirm it is you
reauth.subtitle: Some actions need fresh proof even while signed in.
reauth.oauthOnlyHint: GitHub cannot prove fresh sign-in. Set a login password via verified email — not vault recovery.
reauth.grantHint: The grant is short-lived and tied to this action. Reload clears it.

oauthCallback.invalidFlow: This return link is invalid or expired. Start again from sign in.
oauthCallback.cancelledBody: Nothing changed. Try again or use email and password.
oauthCallback.conflictBody: This provider account is linked to another user.
oauthCallback.errorBody: Could not finish OAuth. Start again from sign in.
oauthCallback.reauthLost: Re-authentication context was lost. Try the action again.
oauthCallback.reauthResume: Confirmed. Repeat the action on the next screen to finish.

errors.invalidCredentials: We do not say which accounts exist. Check both fields.
errors.captchaHint: After several failed attempts, each sign-in needs Turnstile.
errors.lockout: Too many attempts. Try again after {clock} (static display, not a live countdown).
errors.lockoutHint: Limit is 5 attempts per minute per network address.
errors.sessionRevoked: Sign in again to continue. Server data was not deleted.
errors.sessionExpired: Refresh did not succeed. Sign in again.
errors.network: Check your connection, then try again. Nothing was sent.
errors.emailTakenTitle: This email is already in use
errors.emailTaken: Sign in or use another address. We do not say which emails exist on a failed sign-in.
errors.webLocksDegraded: This browser cannot coordinate refresh across tabs. Sign in again when the session expires.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
errors.captchaWidget: Turnstile verification (shown when required by the server).

page.title: Settings
page.subtitle: Account, sessions, and notices. Vault crypto arrives in P03.
page.searchBody: Item names and tags can be embedded on our server. Entry content is not sent. This control ships in P05.
page.dataBody: Decrypted export needs an unlocked vault. Those actions ship with P03 and later phases.

reauth.resume: Confirmed. Repeat the action below to finish.

account.heading: Account
account.passwordBody: Not your vault passphrase. Changing it signs out other sessions.
account.emailPending: Verification sent to {email}. The current address stays until you confirm.
account.passwordReplaced: Login password updated. Other sessions were signed out.
account.patchFailed: Could not save that setting. Your previous choice is still in use.
account.localeBody: Applies to the interface, not entry content.
account.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 12 characters.

security.heading: Security
security.subtitle: Vault crypto controls arrive in P03. Account sessions and audit are live.
security.sessionsEmpty: Only this session is signed in.
security.auditBody: Sign-in, email changes, provider links, session revokes.
security.vaultPlaceholderBody: Passphrase, recovery keys, and passkeys wire in P03.

email.title: Change email
email.description: Your current email stays until the new one is verified.
email.label: New email

password.title: Change login password
password.description: Not your vault passphrase. Other sessions will be signed out.

link.title: Link {provider}
link.description: Re-authenticate before redirecting to the provider.

unlink.title: Unlink {provider}?
unlink.description: You cannot remove your last sign-in method.

reauth.title: Confirm it is you
reauth.description: Enter your login password or use Google if available.

revoke.title: Sign out elsewhere?
revoke.description: Keep this device. Other sessions require re-authentication to revoke.

stateBanner.absentBody: Create your vault first to manage your vault passphrase, recovery keys, and reset options.
stateBanner.lockedBody: Unlock your vault in this browser tab to change your vault passphrase or manage recovery keys. Resetting the vault remained available below as a last resort.
stateBanner.inFlightBody: Another vault operation is currently in progress. Wait for it to finish before starting a new change.

reauth.passwordHint: Account login password (P02), not your vault encryption passphrase (P03).
reauth.oauthBody: Re-authenticate with Google at the start of the flow before entering or generating vault secrets so a page redirect does not wipe your progress.
reauth.oauthRedirectHint: Google re-authentication leaves the page: the vault locks again — unlock it when you return to continue.
reauth.expiredPasswordBody: Your re-authentication grant has less than 60 seconds left. Re-enter your login password in place to finish saving without losing your current step.
reauth.expiredOauthBody: Because Google re-authentication redirects the page, temporary secrets were cleared and nothing was saved on the server. Restart the flow to re-authenticate with Google.

errors.versionMismatchTitle: Vault changed in another tab or device
errors.versionMismatchBody: The vault version on the server changed and nothing was saved from this dialog. Reload the latest vault state and try again if still needed.
errors.versionMismatchKeysBody: The recovery keys shown in this dialog were not saved on the server. Discard any downloaded or printed copy, reload the vault state, and try again.
errors.versionMismatchResetBody: The vault version on the server changed (it may have been recovered elsewhere). Nothing was deleted. Reload the vault state to check before trying again.
errors.preconditionRequired: Vault state precondition was missing or invalid (428). Reload the vault state and try again.
errors.idempotencyConflict: This operation conflicted with another request (409). Reload the vault state and start a fresh attempt.
errors.idempotencyInProgress: This operation is already being processed on the server (409). Wait a moment and retry.
errors.killSwitchDisabled: Vault key mutations are temporarily disabled on the server (503). Your existing vault and passphrase were not changed.
errors.rateLimitedBody: Sensitive vault mutations are limited to 10 per minute. Please wait {seconds} seconds before trying again.
errors.clientBusy: Another vault operation is already in progress in this tab. Wait for it to finish before trying again.
errors.vaultRecovering: The vault is currently in recovery mode. Finish setting your recovery passphrase or lock the vault first before switching flows.
errors.vaultLocked: The vault was locked before this operation finished. Unlock the vault and try again.
errors.staleGeneration: The vault state changed or locked while this operation was running. Nothing was saved — try again.
errors.oomTitle: Not enough memory to derive key
errors.oomBody: This device could not allocate 64 MiB for Argon2id in the Web Worker. Close other tabs or apps and try again — your current passphrase was not changed.
errors.passphraseInvalid: Passphrase contains invalid Unicode characters. Choose a valid passphrase.
errors.recoveryKeySlotTaken: One or more recovery key slots were already filled in another tab (409). Reload the vault state and try again.
errors.recoveryKeyConflict: Generated recovery key conflicted on the server (409). Please try again.
errors.networkError: Could not reach the server. You can safely retry this exact operation without creating duplicate changes.
errors.reauthFailed: Incorrect login password or account re-authentication failed. Please try again.
errors.genericError: Could not complete the vault operation. Please try again.

passphrase.cardBody: Changing your vault passphrase requires account re-authentication and an unlocked vault in this session (via passphrase, passkey, or remembered device). Your old passphrase is not asked. Existing recovery keys and passkeys continue to unlock the vault.
passphrase.dialogDescription: Your vault is unlocked in this session, so the old passphrase is not needed. Re-authenticate your account at the start of the flow before rewrapping the vault key.
passphrase.policyDistinct: Separate from your account login password
passphrase.policyTooShort: Passphrase must be at least 12 characters.
passphrase.policyTooWeak: Passphrase is too easy to guess (requires score ≥ 3).
passphrase.preserveNote: After changing: your {remaining} remaining recovery keys (including old printouts) and {passkeys} passkeys still unlock the vault. Remembered devices stay valid.
passphrase.preserveNoteUnknown: After changing: your remaining recovery keys (including old printouts) and {passkeys} passkeys still unlock the vault. Remembered devices stay valid.
passphrase.doneBody: The passphrase wrap (wrapK) was updated with a new salt. Your {remaining} remaining recovery keys (including old printouts) and {passkeys} passkeys still work. Would you also like to sign out other sessions?
passphrase.doneBodyUnknown: The passphrase wrap (wrapK) was updated with a new salt. Your remaining recovery keys (including old printouts) and {passkeys} passkeys still work. Would you also like to sign out other sessions?

recoveryKeys.statusErrorBody: Could not load recovery key status from the server.
recoveryKeys.statusLockedHint: Unlock the vault to view slot status.
recoveryKeys.cardBody: Each key unlocks the vault on its own. Consuming a key deletes it on the live server. Changing your passphrase does not affect recovery keys — existing printouts still work until each key is used or you rotate all 10.
recoveryKeys.summaryWithEmpty: {remaining} of {slots} keys on server · {emptyCount} empty slots ({slotRange})
recoveryKeys.summaryFull: All 10 of 10 recovery key slots are active on the server.
recoveryKeys.noViewNotice: When 10 of 10 slots are filled, “Regenerate new keys” is disabled (enabled only when at least one slot is empty); use “Rotate all 10” to replace the whole set. Saved secrets are never shown again.

grid.shownOnceWarning: Shown only once. Save these new keys in a safe place outside this browser — screenshots on shared machines put your vault at risk.

regenerate.dialogDescription: Generates new keys only for the {emptyCount} empty slots ({slotRange}), lowest slot first. Your {remaining} existing keys stay unchanged and are never shown again.
regenerate.dialogDescriptionUnknown: Generates new keys only for the {emptyCount} empty slots ({slotRange}), lowest slot first. Your existing keys stay unchanged and are never shown again.
regenerate.reauthBody: Confirm your account before the Worker generates new recovery keys for the empty slots.
regenerate.ackCheckbox: I have saved these new recovery keys in a safe place outside this browser.

rotate.dialogDescription: Requires an unlocked vault and account re-authentication. Replaces all current recovery keys with 10 new keys (rk1…rk10) on the live server.
rotate.reauthBody: Confirm your account before the Worker generates a replacement set of 10 recovery keys.
rotate.warningTitle: Warning: Once saved, all current recovery keys and their printouts stop working on the live server.
rotate.warningBody: Rotating recovery keys does not rotate the vault key (VK) — previously copied wraps or exported backups are not cryptographically revoked.
rotate.ackCheckbox: I have saved all 10 new recovery keys and understand the previous set will stop working on the live server.

reset.cardBody: Permanently deletes all entry contents on the server and resets the vault. Item names and tags are kept. Use only after checking passkeys, your {remaining} remaining recovery keys, remembered devices, open sessions, and backups.
reset.cardBodyUnknown: Permanently deletes all entry contents on the server and resets the vault. Item names and tags are kept. Use only after checking passkeys, your remaining recovery keys (status unavailable), remembered devices, open sessions, and backups.
reset.dialogDescription: Last resort when all unlock paths are lost: permanently deletes all encrypted entry contents on the server while keeping item names and tags.
reset.step1Label: Step 1 of 5 — Try existing unlock paths first: any working path lets you set a new passphrase without losing data.
reset.path3Label: Remembered device — another browser or machine that remembers this vault
reset.path4Label: Existing unlocked session — an open tab or device where the vault is unlocked
reset.step2Title: Export or check your backups before deleting
reset.step2Body: Resetting deletes data on the live server only and does not erase backup files you already hold. Before resetting, check any existing backups or export an encrypted snapshot (.sabk.json, P06) in case you recall an old passphrase or find a printout later.
reset.step3Body: Confirm account ownership with your login password or OAuth provider before proceeding to the final confirmation step (vault.reset).
reset.step3OauthHint: An OAuth sign-in redirect restarts the reset flow at step 1 (steps 1–2 hold no secrets).
reset.step4Body: All encrypted entry contents, the vault key, recovery keys, and passkeys on the server will be permanently deleted. Item names and tags are kept.
reset.confirmInputLabel: Type ĐẶT LẠI or RESET to unlock the reset button
reset.step5Body: All entry contents and previous keys on the server have been deleted. Item names and tags were kept. You must create a new vault before saving new entries.

state.recovering: Recovering vault — set a new passphrase to finish
state.error: Vault error — unlock again to continue
state.busy: Another vault operation is already in progress. Wait for it to finish or lock first.
state.recoveringSwitchHint: Finish setting a new passphrase or lock the vault first to switch flows.

lock.lockedNoticeBody: Decryption keys and cached entry contents in memory were cleared. You can still browse and search item names and tags; unlock again to view or edit entry contents.

passkey.prf_unsupported: This browser or authenticator does not support the WebAuthn PRF extension. You cannot register a passkey. Keep using your passphrase and recovery keys.
passkey.register_failed: Could not register this passkey. Try another authenticator.
passkey.unlock_failed: Could not unlock with this passkey. Use your passphrase or a recovery key.
passkey.unlock_prf_missing: Authenticator did not return PRF. Cannot unlock with passkey.
passkey.none_registered: No passkeys yet. Add one in Settings after unlock.

register.nameHint: 1 to {max} characters. Your authenticator may prompt a second time to evaluate PRF.

name.empty: Enter a name for this passkey.
name.too_long: The passkey name is too long.
name.forbidden_chars: The passkey name contains characters that are not allowed.

register.reauthCancelled: Confirmation was cancelled. The passkey was not added.
register.reauthRestart: Your confirmation expired before the passkey could be saved. Start again to add it.
register.networkUnknown: The connection dropped before we could confirm the passkey was saved. Check the passkey list in Settings before trying again.
register.orphanNotice: The passkey was not saved to your vault. You can delete the extra credential in your device's passkey manager.

add.title: Add a passkey
add.description: Re-authenticate at the start, verify WebAuthn PRF support on your authenticator, and wrap the vault key.
add.googleNote: Google re-authentication leaves the page: the vault locks again, so unlock it before the flow continues.

settings.title: Passkey
settings.body: Unlock your vault with biometrics or a security key. Requires WebAuthn PRF support, checked during registration.

unlock.recoveredNoticeBody: Your new passphrase was saved. Unlock your vault with the new passphrase.
unlock.title: Unlock vault
unlock.lead: Item names and tags remain searchable while locked. Entry contents need your decryption key, and only this browser can open it.
unlock.caption: Slow devices may take a few seconds. Key derivation runs entirely inside your browser.

errors.incorrectPassphraseBody: There is no hint and no remaining-attempts counter — verification happens locally on your device, and the server never knows your passphrase. Use a passkey, a remembered device, or a recovery key if needed.
errors.invalidUnicodeBody: Passphrase contains invalid Unicode characters. Re-type your vault passphrase.
errors.privateKeysWrapInvalidTitle: Could not verify vault key pair
errors.privateKeysWrapInvalidBody: The vault key opened, but the wrapped asymmetric key pair could not be verified. This is not a wrong-passphrase error — reload and try again.
errors.oomTitle: Not enough memory to unlock your vault
errors.oomBodyPrefix: This browser could not allocate 64 MiB in a Web Worker to derive the key from your passphrase.
errors.oomBodyStrong: This does not mean your passphrase is wrong.
errors.oomBodySuffix: Unlock with a passkey or remembered device, close other tabs, or try another device.
errors.busyBody: Another vault operation is currently running in this tab. Wait a moment for it to finish.
errors.recoveringTitle: Recovery is in progress in this tab
errors.recoveringBody: Finish setting a new passphrase on the recovery screen, or lock the vault first to switch back to normal unlock.
errors.sessionExpiredBody: Unlocking the vault requires an active sign-in session. Sign in again to return to this unlock screen.
errors.networkBody: Could not load your encrypted vault bundle. Check your connection and try again.

forgotPassphrase.title: Forgot passphrase
forgotPassphrase.lead: The server cannot read your entry contents, so there is no "reset passphrase by email" link. Instead, use one of the recovery paths you set up.

paths.recoveryKeyBody: Use one unused key from the 10-key set you saved when creating your vault.
paths.passkeyTitle: Passkey or remembered device (arrives in P03-B)
paths.passkeyBody: If you have an active passkey or a remembered device, unlock there and set a new passphrase without the old one.

reauthNote.badge: Re-auth at start of flow · action: vault.recover
reauthNote.title: Re-authenticate your account before entering a recovery key
reauthNote.body: Starting recovery acquires a short-lived vault.recover grant (via your login password or Google OAuth) before you paste your recovery key, so an OAuth redirect never wipes the unwrapped key from the Web Worker.

lastResort.title: If every unlock path is gone: check your encrypted backups first.
lastResort.body: The final option is to reset your vault — permanently deleting all encrypted entry contents while keeping your item names and tags. Resetting only clears the live server; any backup files you hold are untouched.

recovery.invalid: That recovery key is not valid.
recovery.need_new_passphrase: Set a new passphrase to finish recovery.

step1.badge: Re-auth at start of flow · action: vault.recover
step1.title: Confirm your account to start recovery
step1.lead: Before entering a recovery key, confirm your account to obtain a 5-minute vault.recover grant. This ensures an OAuth redirect never wipes your unwrapped key or burns a lookup.
step1.oauthOnlyHint: GitHub cannot prove fresh sign-in. Set a login password via verified email in Settings, or use Google if linked.

step2.title: Enter one recovery key
step2.lead: Paste a single unused key from your set of 10. Hyphens and uppercase/lowercase are normalized automatically.
step2.caption: Limited to 5 lookups per 15 minutes per account. Your plaintext key never leaves this browser — the server only receives a BLAKE2b lookup_hash.

errors.invalidTitle: That recovery key is not valid.
errors.invalidBody: This single message is shown whether the key is malformed, unknown, already used, or belongs to another vault — without revealing how many keys remain. Check the characters or try another key from your set.
errors.rateLimitedTitle: Too many recovery attempts — please wait
errors.rateLimitedBody: Recovery key lookup is limited to 5 requests per 15 minutes per account. Please wait {clock} ({seconds}s · Retry-After: {seconds}) before trying again.
errors.aeadBadge: AEAD open failed · key not consumed
errors.aeadTitle: Could not unwrap the vault key with this recovery key
errors.aeadBody: The server found a matching lookup_hash, but local AEAD decryption failed in your browser. This recovery key was not consumed — try again or use another key from your set.
errors.networkBody: Check your connection and try again. Your recovery key was not consumed.

step3.title: Set a new passphrase to finish recovery.
step3.lead: Your recovery key unwrapped the vault key in temporary Worker memory (recovering). Set a new vault encryption passphrase (distinct from your login password) to finish — this step is required.
step3.recoveringNoteBody: The unwrapped vault key is held only to rewrap with your new passphrase — entry contents cannot be opened and remember-device stays off until recovery completes. Leaving or cancelling now wipes the key from the Worker and does not consume your recovery key.
step3.passphraseHint: Distinct from your account login password. At least 12 characters, zxcvbn ≥ 3.
step3.footerNote: Only after this step succeeds is the recovery key deleted on the live server. Your remaining recovery keys (including old printouts), passkeys, and remembered devices keep working.

policyErrors.tooShort: Passphrase must be at least 12 characters (after Unicode NFC normalization).
policyErrors.tooWeak: Passphrase is too easy to guess. Add more uncommon words or characters until strength reaches Strong (zxcvbn ≥ 3).
policyErrors.invalidUnicode: Passphrase contains invalid Unicode characters. Re-type your passphrase.

errors.reauthExpiredPasswordTitle: Re-authentication expired — confirm your login password in place
errors.reauthExpiredPasswordBody: Your vault.recover grant has less than 60 seconds left or expired. Enter your account login password right here to get a fresh grant without leaving this page — your unwrapped key in the Worker is preserved.
errors.reauthExpiredOauthTitle: Time ran out — please start again
errors.reauthExpiredOauthBody: Re-authenticating with an OAuth provider requires a full-page redirect, which clears Web Worker memory. The unwrapped key was wiped and your recovery key was NOT consumed — start again from step 1 to re-authenticate and reuse the same key.
errors.oomTitle: Not enough memory to derive the new passphrase key
errors.oomBody: This browser could not allocate 64 MiB in the Web Worker to derive a key from your new passphrase. Your recovery key has not been consumed. Close other tabs and retry, or complete recovery on another device.
errors.versionMismatchTitle: Vault was updated in another tab or device
errors.versionMismatchBody: The vault version on the server changed before recovery completed. Nothing from this tab was saved, and your recovery key was not consumed. Reload the latest vault state and start this step again.
errors.preconditionBody: Reload the latest vault state and try again.
errors.idempotencyInProgressTitle: Recovery completion is still in progress
errors.idempotencyInProgressBody: The previous request is still being processed. Wait a moment and retry with the same request key.
errors.idempotencyConflictBody: The request payload changed for the current idempotency key. Reload vault metadata and start again.
errors.mutationsDisabledTitle: Vault key changes are temporarily paused
errors.mutationsDisabledBody: Completing recovery is temporarily disabled for maintenance. Your recovery key was not consumed.
errors.rateLimitedTitle: Too many recovery completion requests — please wait
errors.rateLimitedBody: Recovery completion is limited to 5 requests per 15 minutes (separate bucket from lookup). Please wait {clock} ({seconds}s · Retry-After: {seconds}) before retrying.
errors.networkBody: Your connection dropped before the server confirmed completion. Retry safely — we reuse the exact same Idempotency-Key and request payload.
errors.completedWhileLockedTitle: Recovery completed — unlock with your new passphrase
errors.completedWhileLockedBody: Your new passphrase was saved on the server while this tab locked. Redirecting to unlock with your new passphrase…

step4Reauth.unlockedBanner: Vault unlocked. {remaining} of 10 recovery keys remain active ({emptySlots} empty after being consumed and deleted on the live server).
step4Reauth.allFullBanner: Vault unlocked. All 10 of 10 recovery keys are active.
step4Reauth.title: Re-authenticate before generating replacement keys
step4Reauth.lead: Generating replacement recovery keys for empty slots requires confirming your account at the start of this step — new keys are generated and shown only after re-authentication.
step4Reauth.cardBadge: Re-auth before generating replacement keys · action: vault.recovery_keys_regenerate
step4Reauth.cardBody: Regenerating replacement keys requires a separate vault.recovery_keys_regenerate grant (distinct from vault.recover) before the Worker generates keys for empty slots.
step4Reauth.googleCaption: Google re-authentication leaves the page: the vault locks again — unlock with the new passphrase (or a passkey) before replacement keys are generated.
step4Reauth.skipCaption: You can skip this step and keep {remaining} active keys, or regenerate missing slots anytime in Settings › Security.

wakeGate.title: Checking that your vault is still unlocked…
wakeGate.body: Replacement keys stay hidden and password entry is paused until this check finishes. Your recovery progress is kept.

committedRecheck.verifyingBody: Your new passphrase was saved on the server. We are confirming that your vault is still the one you recovered. Do not reuse the recovery key you just entered.
committedRecheck.recheckTitle: Recovery completed — we could not confirm it yet
committedRecheck.recheckBody: Your new passphrase was saved on the server and the recovery key you entered is used up, but we could not reach the server to confirm the current state of your vault. Check again, or unlock with your new passphrase.
